INSERT INTO vehicle_part (vin, ecu_id, part_no, serial_no, lot_no, installed_at, removed_at) VALUES
(#{r.vin}, #{r.ecuId}, #{r.partNo}, #{r.serialNo}, #{r.lotNo}, #{r.installedAt}, #{r.removedAt})
ON CONFLICT (vin, ecu_id, serial_no) DO UPDATE SET part_no = EXCLUDED.part_no, lot_no = EXCLUDED.lot_no, installed_at = EXCLUDED.installed_at, removed_at = EXCLUDED.removed_at, updated_at = now() WHERE (vehicle_part.part_no, vehicle_part.lot_no, vehicle_part.installed_at, vehicle_part.removed_at) IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.part_no, EXCLUDED.lot_no, EXCLUDED.installed_at, EXCLUDED.removed_at) RETURNING (xmax = 0) AS inserted
